name: Morse code sub
desc: Process-leaning telegraph bass in B minor: a shape-saturated square sub tapping dot-dash rhythm 'letters' that rotate through a four-cycle codebook while iter shifts where each letter starts — the line never quite repeats for 16 bars. Long dashes get elongation (@2), dots stay clipped. Fifth-jump punctuation at phrase ends; peak doubles to 16th dots.

code.sparse: note("<[b1@2 ~ b1 ~ ~ ~ ~] [b1 b1 ~ b1@2 ~ ~ ~] [~ b1 ~ ~ b1@2 ~ ~] [b1@3 ~ ~ b1 ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.01).decay(.35).sustain(.35).release(.15).lpf(${cut}*.8).shape(.4).gain(${gain}*.78).orbit(3).play()
code.full: note("<[b1@2 b1 ~ b1 b1 ~ ~] [b1 b1 b1@2 ~ b1 ~ ~] [b1 ~ b1@2 b1 ~ b1 ~] [b1@2 ~ b1 b1@2 ~ f#1]>").iter(4).add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.005).decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.08).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}).slow(32)).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).mask("<1 1 1 1 1 1 1 [1 0]>").orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[b1 b1 b1@2 b1 b1 b1 ~] [b1@2 b1 b1 ~ b1 f#1 ~] [b1 b1 ~ b1@2 b1 b1 ~] [b1@2 b1 b1 b1@2 ~ f#2]>").iter(8).add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.005).decay(.15).sustain(.3).release(.06).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.6).slow(16)).shape(.55).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.25)).orbit(3).play()
